fsm_states_controller.name: PSEUDO_CHANNEL_ARBITER
fsm_states_controller.description: Arbitrates column commands between the two 32-bit pseudo-channels of a channel.

fsm_states_controller.name: REFRESH_MANAGER
fsm_states_controller.description: Tracks activate counts, issues RFM, adapts refresh to TEMP.

fsm_states_controller.name: ECC_RAS_HANDLER
fsm_states_controller.description: Processes link/on-die ECC reports, CA-parity alerts, initiates soft-repair.

fsm_hints.trigger: Power-up / RESET_n -> voltage ramp -> initialization -> TRAINING (CA / write-leveling / read / write, DFE, VrefDQ/VrefCA, ZQ) -> READY. Each access: ACTIVATE (tRCD) -> READ/WRITE (BL16) -> PRECHARGE (tRP).
fsm_hints.rule: Honor tRCD/tRP/tRAS/tRFC/tCCD/tWR/CL; refresh (REFab/REFsb) must meet tREFI so cells retain data; the two sub-channels are scheduled independently.
fsm_hints.refresh: REFab refreshes all banks; REFsb refreshes the same bank across groups while other banks stay accessible.

anti_deadlock_rule: Single controller masters all command/address; the DRAM is a target with no command-bus contention. Per-channel independence prevents one channel from blocking another. RFM is mandatory to prevent disturbance-induced data loss under sustained high activate rates.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-up the rails ramp (1.1 V VDD/VDDQ, 1.8 V VPP), RESET_n is released, the device initializes, then training runs (CA training, write leveling, read/write training with DFE tap and VrefDQ/VrefCA centering, ZQ calibration via MPC) per sub-channel before normal operation.

default_ready_state_recommendation.idle: Banks precharged (IDLE); the controller issues REFab/REFsb within tREFI.
default_ready_state_recommendation.access: ACTIVATE a row (tRCD), then READ/WRITE columns at BL16, then PRECHARGE (tRP).

configurations.name: UDIMM / SODIMM
configurations.description: Unbuffered module; two sub-channels; on-module PMIC + SPD hub; no RCD.

configurations.name: RDIMM
configurations.description: Registered module; RCD re-drives CK/CA to the DRAMs.

configurations.name: LRDIMM
configurations.description: Load-reduced module; RCD plus data buffers (DB).

timing_dependency_rule: A column access requires its row open (ACTIVATE + tRCD); a new row in the same bank requires PRECHARGE + tRP; tCCD_L gates column-to-column within a bank group and tCCD_S across groups; tWR must elapse after a write before precharge; refresh (tRFC) must complete before accessing refreshed banks.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: RESET
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: RESET_n asserted; channel in known state; mode registers undefined.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: INITIALIZATION
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: Supply ramp, RESET_n deassertion, mode-register programming, ECC/RFM config, link training.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: BANK_ACTIVE
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: A row is open; column READ/WRITE allowed on the C bus.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: READING
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: Burst read; DRAM drives DQ + RDQS for the addressed pseudo-channel.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: WRITING
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: Burst write; controller drives DQ + WDQS for the addressed pseudo-channel.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: PRECHARGING
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: Open row being closed; bitlines restored.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: REFRESHING
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: REFRESH/RFM in progress; no column access during the window.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: POWER_DOWN
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: Per-channel low-power; clock may be gated; fast exit.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: SELF_REFRESH
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: DRAM self-refreshes; channel clock may stop; exit re-synchronizes.

fsm_states_bank.name: IDLE / PRECHARGED
fsm_states_bank.description: All rows in the bank are precharged; the bank is ready for ACTIVATE.

fsm_states_bank.name: ACTIVATING
fsm_states_bank.description: ACTIVATE opens a row; wait tRCD before a column access.

fsm_states_bank.name: ACTIVE
fsm_states_bank.description: A row is open; READ / WRITE column accesses (BL16) proceed.

fsm_states_bank.name: PRECHARGING
fsm_states_bank.description: PRECHARGE closes the row; wait tRP before the next ACTIVATE.

fsm_states_device.name: RESET / INIT
fsm_states_device.description: Power-up, RESET_n, voltage ramp, then initialization.

fsm_states_device.name: TRAINING
fsm_states_device.description: CA training, write leveling, read/write training (DFE taps, VrefDQ/VrefCA centering), ZQ calibration via MPC.

fsm_states_device.name: READY
fsm_states_device.description: Device trained and ready to service commands on both sub-channels.

fsm_states_device.name: SELF_REFRESH
fsm_states_device.description: Low-power retention with internal refresh; exit returns to READY.
